questions.question: What was the title of Rafał's 2008 text in Rzeczpospolita?
questions.explanation: Rafał recalls the text with the title from Wyspiański: "We have forgotten everything".

questions.question: What does Rafał call the "damned symmetry"?
answers: The balance of power in the EU
Comparing genocide with "Poles also hurt people"
questions.explanation: The drawing-room "symmetries" trivialise Volhynia: "Poles also hurt people, right?"

questions.question: What scene from Shevchenko's poem does Rafał recall?
answers: Ivan Gonta murdering his own children
The signing of a peace treaty
questions.explanation: In "The Haidamakas" the key scene: Ivan Gonta murders his own children for their "Polish blood".

questions.question: What did Rafał receive the medal from the Kresy community for?
answers: For taking part in the European Parliament
questions.explanation: The Kresy community honours those who have not forgotten — Rafał received the medal for reminding.

questions.question: What is Rafał more afraid of than the vipers from Kaczmarski's ballad?
questions.explanation: Rafał says: he is not afraid of vipers — he is afraid of silence and oblivion.
